title: Generative design of de novo AAV vectors with unique serological profiles
summary: A variational autoencoder trained on natural AAV sequences generated capsid proteins de novo; more than 255 designs were synthesized and tested in vitro. Seven designs transduced human cells at over 50% efficiency, and four of these avoided neutralization by all AAV-reactive human sera tested (NT50 < 1:50).
ai_technology: Variational autoencoder (generative model of AAV capsid sequences)

evidence.tested: More than 255 AI-generated capsid designs were synthesized and tested in vitro; seven transduced human cells above 50% efficiency and four avoided neutralizing antibodies in all reactive human sera.
evidence.unknown: Tested in vitro only; the in vivo performance and the full set of limits are not stated in the reviewed abstract.
evidence.ai_role: A variational autoencoder learned AAV sequence constraints from natural sequences and generated functional capsid proteins de novo, with a second design campaign exploring uncertain regions.
